Former President Barack Obama, former President Joe Biden, former President George W. Bush, former President Bill Clinton and their wives are at Friday morning’s New York City 9/11 ceremony.
 
9/11 25th anniversary live updates: https://t.co/WOhRCFFhXR https://t.co/dXjfysfNmb
On Sept. 11, 2001, at 9:59 a.m., millions watched on TV as the South Tower collapsed. #momentofsilence https://t.co/pM8NTVBO33
At 9:37 a.m. on Sept. 11, 2001, Flight 77, which had been headed to Los Angeles, crashed into the Pentagon near Washington, D.C. #momentofsilence https://t.co/i4zabua8LV
